why: Insight lab 2026-W44, candidate 1 (medium): WordPress +6.9 readiness points, explained by SEO-plugin schema defaults. n=213, 26 Oct 2026, purposive sample.
title: X thread: the WordPress schema gap

drafts.text: WordPress homepages scored 6.9 points higher than every other platform in a sample of 213 small B2B SaaS, agency and professional-services sites. 84.5 vs 77.6, 95% interval 3.7 to 10.2.
thread: The gap is schema. Organization or WebSite JSON-LD on 95% of WordPress homepages vs 68% of the rest. Content schema: 73% vs 27%.
Mechanism: 15 of 20 WordPress homepages we rechecked ran Yoast or Rank Math. Every Yoast one carried BreadcrumbList. The plugin wrote it.
Crawler access goes the other way: WordPress sites average 17.3 of 26 access points vs 19.0, mostly from a default admin-path Disallow.
Monday morning: on Webflow, headless or custom code, check the homepage for Organization and WebSite JSON-LD. Missing means add it by hand.

Method: 213 homepages found by web search, not random. Scanned 26 Oct 2026, one scan each. Readiness only. Confidence: medium. Free scan: https://getcitehound.com/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=field-notes&utm_content=insight-2026-W44-1-x
